title: estate component version register (STD-OPS-02, estate-ci#121)
description: One file per owner repository, version-register.json at the repository root. Lists every operator, runtime and appliance the repository owns, with what is installed, the upstream it tracks and its support date. A locally patched build also records its upstream base, patch set, rebase owner and SLA class. A row may point at another machine-readable register in the same repository (for example proxmox-infrastructure version_targets) instead of copying its values. Validated by deploy/foundation/bin/lint-version-register.py, which also checks what JSON Schema cannot: unique component names, ref targets that exist, and a digest on every patched build.

owner.description: The owner repository, as in the estate ownership record.

component.description: A register row: either a full entry (installed, upstream, support) or a pointer (ref) to another register in this repository.

source.description: Where the installed reading comes from: a repo path, a command or a live read.

project.description: Upstream project or vendor release page URL.

until.description: End of vendor support or end-of-life date for the installed release.

policy.description: rolling: only the latest release is supported, so the measure is installed against upstream latest.

source.description: URL of the published support or EOL policy.

patched.description: Present only for a locally patched build (a first-party fork image).

upstream_base.description: Upstream release or tag the patch set applies to.

patch_set.description: Repo path, PR or issue URL holding the patches.

rebase_owner.description: Owner repository that rebases the patch set onto new upstream releases.

sla_class.description: STD-OPS-01 patch window: critical 7 days, standard 30 days.

pointer.description: pointer: ref to another register in this repository, no copied versions

file.description: Repo-relative path of the register that holds the values.

key.description: Dotted key path in that file, for example version_targets or version_targets.k3s.
